articles.title: Leicester hold off Newcastle for first Prem win
articles.standfirst: Leicester Tigers pick up their first win of the season with a tense and hard-fought victory at Newcastle Red Bulls in the Prem.

gist: Leicester Tigers defeated Newcastle Red Bulls to secure their first win of the season.
Former Newcastle winger Adam Radwan scored against his old club during the match.
Newcastle mounted a late comeback effort but ultimately fell short at home.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Leicester Tigers won their first match of the season with a hard-fought victory away against Newcastle Red Bulls. Tries from Samiuela Moli, Adam Radwan and Will Hurd helped Leicester establish a lead, while Billy Searle contributed with conversions and a penalty. Newcastle responded with scores from Obi Ene, George McGuigan and Cameron Jordan, alongside kicks from Brett Connon and Zack Henry, but Leicester held on to win.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The victory marked Leicester's first win in seven matches across all competitions, ending a poor run of form stretching back into the previous season. For Newcastle, the defeat came in their first home match of the campaign despite a positive showing and a late comeback attempt.

sections.text: The comprehensive victory highlights Gloucester's strong form and character, particularly through a disciplined defence that kept their opponents scoreless.
